passivation annealing has a significant effect on the electromigration lifetime of the stack.
passivation annealing has an effect on the electromigration resistance of the hybrid bonding stack.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
passivation final annealings are not recommended for the considered stack.
the bonding process is not the weak point of the hybrid bonding stack and that the passivation process has a significant impact on electromigration lifetime.
passivation annealing can be used to tune the reliability of the stack.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the passivation anneal is a key step for hybrid bonding reliability and must be optimized to ensure long-term stability.
the bonding and passivation steps have an important impact on the reliability performance.
passivation final annealings should be avoided to preserve the lifetime of the interconnects.
